In 0/U set internalField uniform (0 0 0) with noSlip on all solid walls and empty on front/back.
In 0/T set internalField uniform 300, bottom fixedValue 305, top fixedValue 295, sides zeroGradient, and front/back empty.
In 0/p set internalField uniform 0 with walls calculated and front/back empty; in 0/p_rgh set internalField uniform 0 with walls fixedFluxPressure and front/back empty.

- epsilon: inlet/outlet are cyclic; topWall/bottomWall use epsilonWallFunction with value uniform 1.875e-4.

Solution Control: In system/fvSolution, use GAMG for p with tolerance 1e-6, and smoothSolver for U, k, epsilon with tolerance 1e-5. Use the SIMPLE algorithm for pressure-velocity coupling.
